learning_outcomes.text: Learns the areas where power electronics circuits are used in industry.
Understands the relationship of power electronics circuits with other electrical branches and devices.
Can design circuits in MATLAB-SIMULINK environment.

syllabus_topics: Operating Principle, Characteristics and Types of Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS)
Examination of Various Uninterruptible Power Supplies
Operating Principle, Characteristics and Types of Switched Mode Power Supplies (SMPS)
Examination of Various Switched Mode Power Supplies
Design of Switched Mode Power Supplies
Operating Principle, Characteristics and Types of Resonant Mode Power Supplies (RMPS)
Operating Principle, Characteristics of Induction Heating (IH) Systems
Examination of Various Induction Heating Systems
Operating Principle, Characteristics and Types of Electronic Ballasts (EB)
Examination of Basic Power Factor Correction (PFC) Circuits
Examination of Basic Active Filter (AF) Circuits
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course schedule. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of the University Senate.
bibliography: Power Electronics: Converters, Applications, and Design 3rd Edition, Ned Mohan, Tore M. Undeland, William P. Robbins
Güç Elektroniği Yarı İletken Elemanlar ,Devreler Ve Uygulamaları, Muhammad H.Rashid, Editörler: M. Timur Aydemir , Sedat Sünter, Nobel Yayınevi, 2015.
Güç Elektroniği (Temel Analiz ve Sayısal Uygulamalar) Hacı Bodur, Birsen Yayınevi, 2010.
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
